# Security policy

kuizer deletes files, so a bug that removes something it should not is a security issue. Report it privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/remcostoeten/kuizer/security/advisories/new) rather than in a public issue. Include the kuizer version, the operating system, the config file if it differs from the defaults, and the steps that reproduce it.

A fix ships in a new release as soon as it is ready, and the advisory is published with it. Only the latest release is supported.
